'''Anaiya Carel''' (pronounced: ah-NYE-yah) was an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Blue Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Anaiya Carel|Anaiya}} Evidence suggests that she was at one time the Blue Ajah [[First Selector]].

==Appearance and Personality==
Anaiya stood about 5'6" tall and was dark haired with a homely 'blunt face'.{{ref/book|2|4}} She had a warm smile. According to Moiraine, "almost everyone felt comforted, safe and special, when Anaiya smiled at them".{{ref/book|2|4}} Anaiya enjoyed beautiful clothing and had a fondness for wearing lace and ruffles.{{ref/book|10|20}}

She was astute politically and a first-rate organizer.{{ref||Anaiya}}  Likely this was one of the reasons she was included among the [[Salidar Six]]. Moiraine calls her open, honest, and "accepting of everyone" while still able to see into the heart of the matter.{{ref/book|2|4}} She was not a flighty woman. Instead, she was deliberate, unflappable, and careful with her words.{{ref/book|10|19}} 

She is kind towards children. When in Fal Dara, she ruffles the heads of playing boys as she passes.{{ref/book|2|4}} She is less formal than many Aes Sedai in other ways, asking [[Amalisa Jagad]] to call her by her first name only, while asking permission to call her merely "Amalisa".{{ref/book|2|4}} Egwene thinks that she is "different from the others, more like a woman from home".{{ref/book|2|12}} 

==Strength and Abilities==
Anaiya was [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] in the [[One Power]] by Aes Sedai standards, with a level of {{opsl|21}}.{{ref/book|0|12}}{{ref||Anaiya}} She is among the top tier of channelers among the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]]. Among the [[Salidar Six]], she is as strong as [[Carlinya Sorevin]], [[Morvrin Thakanos]] and [[Myrelle Berengari]], but not as strong as [[Sheriam Bayanar]].{{ref/book|5|27}} 

She had a strong ability at [[Healing]], and was exceptionally adept at caring for the wounded. 

She had an interest in lost [[Talent]]s, so much so that some thought she should have been a Brown. This included [[Dreaming]] and she tested Egwene on the ability. Moiraine says Anaiya belonged in the Brown when she raises an interest in channelers among the [[Aiel]].{{ref/book|2|4}}

==History==
Anaiya was born in the year {{ne|868}} and went to the Tower in {{ne|883}}. After spending eight years as Novice and seven as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|898}}.{{ref||Anaiya}} 

She, [[Cabriana Mecandes]] and [[Kairen Stang]] were nicknamed "The Three" because they did not share any of their activities with anyone else except each other.{{ref/book|10|23}} The Brown [[Sitter]] [[Janya Frende]] was another dear friend of Anaiya.

When [[Verin Mathwin]] injured herself in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', she went to Anaiya for [[Healing]]{{ref/book|3|21}}.

Anaiya was present at [[Moiraine Damodred]]'s test for the shawl and Healed her afterwards. She was then the first to greet both Moiraine and [[Siuan Sanche]] to the Blue Ajah living quarters{{ref/book|0|12}}.

She once Healed Moiraine after Lan rode a horse to death, and nearly ran himself to death carrying Moiraine to her.{{ref/book|2|22}}  Moiraine liked her a lot, though Siuan preferred [[Lelaine Akashi|Lelaine]].

She had a single [[Warder]], [[Setagana]].{{ref/book|10|16}}

==Activities==
===At Fal Dara===
She was one of two representatives for the Blue Ajah sent to [[Fal Dara]]{{ref/book|2|2}} as part of the [[Amyrlin]]'s entourage.{{ref/book|2|4}} While traveling back to the White Tower, she began lessons with [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]]{{ref/book|2|11}}. She was the first to believe that Egwene may be a Dreamer{{ref/book|2|12}}.

She was one of the Aes Sedai who Healed Mat from his link to the dagger from Shadar Logoth. She enclosed the dagger in a metal box {{ref/book|3|18}}.

She examines Mat and finds he is well although still in need of a lot of nourishment just before he leaves for Tear. She seems amused by his preparations to leave since she "knows" he can not get off the island.{{ref/book|3|30}}

===Rebellion===
She was one of the original leaders of the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]], known informally to fans as the [[Salidar Six]], having fled the [[White Tower]] following [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]'s usurpattion{{ref/book|5|26}}.

When Min, Siuan, Leane, and Logain arrived at Salidar, Anaiya asked Leane and Siuan several questions that only they could know the answers to, since being stilled affected their appearance {{ref/book|5|26}}.

While searching the Amyrlin's study in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' for information on what Elaida has received, the Salidar Six were attacked by a stray nightmare of [[Trollocs]]. They were saved when [[Elayne Trakand]] and Siuan reminded them about the dream not being real, after which the nightmare faded away leaving only injury{{ref/book|6|7}}.

When a bubble of evil attacked Salidar, she took control of a link that contains Elayne, Nynaeve and [[Nicola Treehill]] to destroy all the inanimate objects that have come to life. It was during this time she observed Nicola have her first [[Foretelling]]{{ref/book|6|14}}.

She was with the rest of the Salidar Six in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'', when she summoned Egwene to become Amyrlin{{ref/book|6|34}}.

She showed [[Matrim Cauthon]] to Nicola, who has the Talent of seeing ''[[ta'veren]]''{{ref/book|6|38}}.

She was also a member of [[Egwene's Council]]. 
She swore an oath of fealty to Egwene. Egwene sent her on a secret meeting to meet with the group of nobles that blocked the Salidar army on the border of [[Andor]]{{ref/book|7|15}}.

She was with Egwene and Gareth when they surveyed the area around Tar Valon {{ref/book|10|16}}.

===Murder===
Anaiya and her Warder were murdered the night the [[Hall of the Tower under Egwene al'Vere|Rebel Hall]] voted to make an [[Black Tower Alliance|alliance]] with the [[Black Tower]]. [[Nisao Dachen]] found them{{ref/book|10|20}} and, after testing for resonance, determined they had been killed by suffocation with an air weave of ''[[saidin]]''. {{ref/book|10|20}}

[[Aran'gar]], in the guise of [[Halima]], had killed them to prevent them from betraying her lie of being a companion of Cabriana; and possibly with the secondary goal of discouraging the Rebel Hall from forming an alliance with the Black Tower.

Egwene was saddened at her death, not only because she liked Anaiya, but also because Anaiya was one of the few who thought Egwene might really have the talent of [[Dreaming]]. Anaiya's death meant the other Aes Sedai would be less likely to believe in Egwene's talent.

===First Selector?===
She might have been the [[First Selector]] of the Blue Ajah before she was murdered, and even if not, she was certainly someone who many Blues listened closely to. Several indications have occurred that support this idea, although there is no hard evidence for this. First and foremost, Moiraine's cryptic "I will leave [[Hall of the Tower|the Hall]] to you, Anaiya" {{ref/book|2|4}} suggests that Anaiya held a station of importance, and she was not a [[Sitter]]. Secondly, [[Lelaine Akashi]] was not mentioned as the First Selector until [[Knife of Dreams]], after Anaiya's death. Thirdly, it is likely that the First Selector would be one of the Salidar Six, but she probably gave way for [[Sheriam]] (who acted as unofficial leader of the six) so as not to reveal herself.  When Myrelle (secretly Captain-General of the Green) promises every Green sister behind Sheriam as a choice of Amyrlin, Anaiya seems about to say the same about the Blue sisters.{{Ref/book|6|27}} In short, she is the most likely First Selector for the main part of the series.
